philippines.title: Nextone’s ‘Nagkulang’ turns relationship overthinking into an upbeat track
philippines.description:
Rising Filipino pop-rock band NEXTONE has turned the familiar feeling of questioning oneself after a failed relationship into an upbeat new single, “Nagkulang.” Released under Sony Music Entertainment, the song explores self-doubt and overthinking after a romantic fallout, while taking a more energetic approach to heartbreak through lively rhythms. For bassist and songwriter Elijah del Rosario, the song’s concept was not something the band had planned from the beginning. “Ang funny kasi yung ‘Nagkulang,’ yung latest single namin, isn’t something talaga na napag-isipan namin,” he told reporters during the song’s official launch at a bar in Marikina City.
